career_ladder.note: Governed by the Telangana Police (Subordinate Service) Rules and Telangana Police Service (TPS) Rules. Direct-entry Sub-Inspectors in Civil, AR, and TGSP undergo 1 year of foundation and specialized tactical training at the Telangana State Police Academy (TSPA), Himayathsagar, followed by 1 year of practical police station attachment prior to confirmation.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment examination consists of three stages: Stage I Preliminary Written Test (PWT, 200 marks, screening only), Stage II Physical Measurement Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and Stage III Final Written Examination (FWE) of 4 papers. In FWE, Papers I & II (English and Telugu/Urdu, 100 marks each) are qualifying only. For Civil SI (Post Code 11), Station Fire Officer (17), and Deputy Jailors (18/19), final merit is drawn from Paper III (200 marks) + Paper IV (200 marks) = 400 marks total. For AR (12), SAR CPL (13), TGSP (14), and SPF (16), final merit is drawn from Paper III (100 marks) + Paper IV (100 marks) + PET Run (100 marks) = 300 marks total.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Preliminary Written Test (PWT) (Objective Type, Screening Only)
stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 225/Rect./Rect.-1/2026 (Para 16-A & Annexure-II Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: Preliminary Written Test (Part A: Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning / Mental Ability - 100 Qs; Part B: General Studies & Telangana Movement - 100 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: 20% (1/5th) negative marks for each incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30% for OC/EWS (60/200), 25% for BC (50/200), 20% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (40/200)

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 225/Rect./Rect.-1/2026 (Para 16-B & Annexure-I Gradation Table)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Men: 7 min 15 sec (Ex-Servicemen: 9 min 30 sec); Women: 5 min 20 sec (Scored out of 100 for AR/TGSP/SAR CPL/SPF; qualifying for Civil/Fire/Jailor)

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Qualifying Events (Long Jump & Shot Put)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Height: Men 167.6 cm (Agency ST 160 cm), Women 152.5 cm (Agency ST 150 cm); Long Jump: Men 4.0m (Ex-SM 3.5m), Women 2.5m; Shot Put (7.26kg Men / 4kg Women): Men 6.0m, Women 4.0m

stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 225/Rect./Rect.-1/2026 (Para 16-C & Annexure-III Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: Paper I: English (Part A Objective MCQs 25 Marks with 25% negative marking; Part B Descriptive Précis/Letter/Essay 75 Marks)
papers.negative_marking: 25% negative marking in Part A only; Part B is descriptive
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (qualifying paper, marks not added to final merit)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Telugu / Urdu (Part A Objective MCQs 25 Marks with 25% negative marking; Part B Descriptive Précis/Letter/Essay 75 Marks)
papers.negative_marking: 25% negative marking in Part A only; Part B is descriptive
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (qualifying paper, marks not added to final merit)

papers.paper_name: Paper III: Arithmetic and Test of Reasoning / Mental Ability (Objective Type, 200 Questions)
papers.negative_marking: Deleted questions compensated proportionately; no negative marking in FWE
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (200 marks for Civil/Fire/Jailor; 100 marks for AR/TGSP/SPF)

papers.paper_name: Paper IV: General Studies (Objective Type, 200 Questions: General Science, Current Events, Indian History, Geography, Polity & Economy, Personality/Ethics, Telangana Movement & State Formation)
papers.negative_marking: Deleted questions compensated proportionately; no negative marking in FWE
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (200 marks for Civil/Fire/Jailor; 100 marks for AR/TGSP/SPF)

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Telangana are appointed under the Telangana Revised Pay Scales 2020 (RPS 2020), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.51, Finance (HRM.IV) Department, dated 11/06/2021. The post is placed in Scale 17 (₹42,300 – 1,15,270) with an Entry Basic Pay of ₹42,300 (Station Fire Officers and Deputy Jailors are in Scale 15: ₹38,890 – 1,12,510). Dearness Allowance (DA) is calculated at the standardized project review constant of 58% effective 2025-07-01. House Rent Allowance (HRA) is governed by G.O.Ms.No.53 Finance Department (24% for Greater Hyderabad/Cyberabad/Rachakonda municipal areas, 13% for district headquarters/corporations, and 11% for other locations).
financial_package.pay_source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 225/Rect./Rect.-1/2026 Para 1 & G.O.Ms.No.51 Finance (HRM.IV) Dept Dt.11/06/2021
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross calculated on entry basic pay of ₹42,300 with 58% project constant DA (₹24,534), HRA ranging from 11% (₹4,653 in mofussil police sub-divisions) to 24% (₹10,152 in GHMC Hyderabad/Cyberabad/Rachakonda commissionerate jurisdictions) governed by G.O.Ms.No.53 Finance Department, plus executive police allowance, conveyance allowance, and uniform kit maintenance (~₹2,500–₹4,500). In-hand reflects deductions: 10% NPS contribution on Basic+DA (₹6,683), Professional Tax (₹200), and TSGLI/GIS/EHS deductions (~₹1,000–₹1,500).
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) indexed to AICPI as per Government of Telangana Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 11%, 13%, or 24% of basic pay based on location classification
Executive police allowance, conveyance allowance, and uniform maintenance allowance
Government accommodation (police quarters / officers' flats in police lines or HRA in lieu thereof)
Employee Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical treatment for self and recognized dependent family members
Telangana State Government Life Insurance (TSGLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) coverage
NPS pension benefits with 14% state employer contribution
Official communication facility, CUG mobile reimbursement, and duty travel allowances
